assertions: The response routes to the chemprop uncertainty-advanced sub-skill.

The response emits a chemprop predict command with --uncertainty-method mve, --cal-path calibration.csv, --calibration-method zscaling, and --evaluation-methods nll-regression miscalibration_area ence spearman.
The response explains that the mve estimator is valid only for a regression-mve-trained model.
The response explains that --evaluation-methods require the prediction/test CSV to contain target labels matching the model output columns.
The response explains the conformal-alpha 0.1 quantile-regression/conformal-regression path for quantile models, or correctly notes the calibration/evaluation coupling.
The response does not tell the user to open the original Chemprop source or tests.
